arena.why: static geoms with no joints: a world can put steps and props between them and cannot move them. The inner faces are where a step block has to stop.

bank.parkedWhy: 10 of the 14 blocks are at the park mark, (i·1.5, −5) — parked, not absent: this plant compiles the bank and a world chooses how many of it to use. The other 4 are listed in `steps`, wherever they actually are. Nothing is parked until a world parks it.
bank.sizeWhy: the bank is 14 identical 0.34×0.34×0.2 m blocks; a step is placed by moving one, so a different size is not something this world can be asked for.
bank.stackedAtBoot: nothing parks this bank in the live world: it boots stacked at (0, 1.305, 0) and every live number ever published was measured with it there. A flat room is a change, not a default.
bank.yWhy: every block is COMPILED at y = 1.305 with an x and a z slide and no y joint, so this is where the blocks are and not where a request puts them. Moving them means recompiling the scene (site/stairs.js STAIR_Y).
